page_title: REN 4-1 MON | Rennes v Monaco 22/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' 4 - 1 Goal! Vanderson plays a simple square pass into the feet of Mika Biereth (Monaco) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 4:1.

90+3' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco. A short pass finds Valentin Rongier (Rennes). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
90+1' Substitution. Przemyslaw Frankowski makes his way off the pitch and Alidu Seidu (Rennes) comes on as his replacement.
90+1' Habib Beye has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Rosier (Rennes) replacing Breel Embolo.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The ball goes out for a corner. Monaco can continue in their attacking effort.
87' Some patient build-up play from Monaco as they look to unlock the defence.
85' Substitution. Mousa Tamari walks off the pitch and Glen Kamara (Rennes) comes on as a substitute.
85' Here is a change. Mamadou Coulibaly is going off and Sebastien Pocognoli gives the last tactical orders to Paul Pogba (Monaco).
83' 4 - 0 Goal! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes a long run up and buries the penalty inside the right post.
83' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is going to take the penalty!

82' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Rennes have been awarded a penalty kick!

81' A neat pass is well received by Mousa Tamari (Rennes), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
79' Rennes are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
79' Lamine Camara (Monaco) sends an accurate pass to Kassoum Ouattara, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
75' Habib Beye prepares a substitution. Esteban Lepaul is replaced by Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
75' It's time for a substitution. Quentin Merlin (Rennes) comes on in place of Djaoui Cisse.
73' 3 - 0 Goal! Breel Embolo (Rennes) makes the score 3:0 after burying a close-range header in the left side of the goal after a good run and cross by Przemyslaw Frankowski.
73' Rennes take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
72' 50:50 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
70' Sebastien Pocognoli has decided to substitute Maghnes Akliouche and he is replaced by Lamine Camara (Monaco).
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vanderson (Monaco) replaces Krepin Diatta.
69' Rennes control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
65' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and the referee sends him off!
64' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Rennes are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
61' Monaco play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass. The ball is out of play. Monaco will take a throw-in.
61' Sebastien Pocognoli decides to make a substitution. George Ilenikhena will be replaced by Mika Biereth (Monaco).
61' Substitution. Takumi Minamino (Monaco) in, Ansu Fati out.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.
57' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
54' Brice Samba (Rennes) tries to find Przemyslaw Frankowski, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a throw-in.
52' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rennes.

50' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Mousa Tamari (Rennes) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Lukas Hradecky pulls off a brilliant save.
48' 2 - 0 Mahdi Camara (Rennes) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the middle of the goal, and thus alter the score to 2:0.
47' Rennes take a short corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Jordan Teze (Monaco) takes the corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' The Rennes players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.

42' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Rennes have a free kick.
39' The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Monaco move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.

33' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
32' The referee points to the corner flag and Monaco will take a corner.
31' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts George Ilenikhena (Monaco) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.
28' The ratio of the ball possession is 43:57.
28' Monaco are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
25' Ansu Fati (Monaco) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
20' 1 - 0 Spectacular goal! Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) brilliantly darts into the box to latch on to a cross and buries the ball inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper stunned!
19' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows a yellow card to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) for his blatant foul.
15' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rennes.
13' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.
10' The Rennes players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
6' Ansu Fati (Monaco) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
6' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) has a goal ruled out for offside!
5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

4' Monaco players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Rennes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Rennes will take the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem will officiate today.
